author: Home Repair Tutor
description: DITRA-HEAT Peel and Stick tips near toilets…I’m using a closet flange spacer to make an accurate cut. Then I apply PRIMER-PS to the substrate and allow it to cure. These mats are easy to align and install, no mortar is needed. I use a wood float to activate the pressure-sensitive adhesive and bond the mat to the floor.
